bullets.text: Ukraine launched strikes on two oil refineries deep within Russian territory, with President Zelenskyy stating the attacks aim to limit Russia's war financing revenues.
Authorities in the Democratic Republic of Congo are concerned that the Ebola virus responsible for a large outbreak may be mutating, as cases have exceeded 4,000.
Nigerian security forces successfully rescued over 300 hostages in the Kainji Lake national park, an operation hailed as the 'largest single-day recovery' by the president.
The Bureau of Meteorology has ordered an inquiry following a tumultuous year, as farmers express a loss of trust in the accuracy of weather information crucial for agricultural decisions.
The criminal trial of veteran broadcaster Alan Jones has commenced, nearly two years after his arrest on multiple charges of indecent assault and sexual touching, which he denies.
One Nation leader Pauline Hanson is facing accusations of using party funds to cover the cost of a stay at a five-star hotel in London last month.
Japanese beverage maker Kirin Holdings Co. is set to acquire Canadian vitamins and supplements firm Jamieson Wellness Inc. in a deal valued at approximately $1.4 billion.
Alphabet Inc. successfully raised $25 billion through a bond sale, which saw strong demand due to generous yield payouts, marking one of the largest order books for AI-related debt this year.

Jane Street, a secretive trading firm, is reportedly in discussions to move its $11 billion in debt to investors, including Pimco, through a private credit deal that would enable further investments in AI.
